doc: Footsteps and movement foley (M2-AUD-05, M3-AUD-802; docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md "Footsteps"). FootstepAudio (game/audio/footstep_audio.gd) listens to the field walker. contacts: when the walker's `body` child (HeroFieldActor's HeroBody) or the walker has the `signal` signal, each emission is a step (its `run_arg` argument, hero-integration's foot_contact(foot, run), says walk or run; without one the pace does); else each contact marker (`markers`, M2-CHR-12's heel contacts) that its AnimationTree's clip nodes (in a 1D blend space, the dominant clip at or over min_weight) or its playing AnimationPlayer cross is a step, a run when the clip is in run_clips. Contacts within min_interval_sec are one step; stall_m of walking with no contact plays a distance step; the body is looked for every retry_sec until found. Without contacts: every walk_step_m (below run_above_m_s) or run_step_m of horizontal distance is a step. Each step plays the surface's walk or run row at the feet (quieter by walk_db when walking) and the foley: cloth on every step, the hero's gear (by the body's hero_id, else gear_default) every gear_every steps, each at its *_db on top of the gait's. stop: a walk that slowed from from_m_s to under below_m_s (or stood still stop_sec) after min_steps steps plays the surface's stop row. turn: a change of travel heading of min_deg within window_sec at min_m_s or more plays the turn row (cooldown_sec apart). A walk ends after stop_sec without movement (frames between physics ticks read none) and restarts first_step of a stride in. Moves under still_m per frame are idle jitter; a jump over teleport_m is a warp, not a walk. speed_smooth_sec smooths the pace. surfaces: surface -> {walk, run, stop, turn} sfx rows (or one row for every gait). The surface is the ground's: the highest surface_priority node in group surface_areas.group (its `surface` meta) or in group group_prefix + <surface> whose collision shapes hold the feet; else scenes[scene], else default. tools/validate_data.py checks the rows and scenes. Strides (M3-AUD-802, hero-integration ADR 0191): the field walks at 1.0 m/s and runs at 3.6 m/s (field_movement.json); a step is half a stride (Rhen: walk 0.53 m, run 1.0 m, per characters' locomotion.json), so the distance stepper uses those, and run_above_m_s is the midpoint of the two gaits (2.3), since the smoothed pace (speed_smooth_sec) would take about 0.5 s to pass a threshold set just under the run speed. Act II (M4-A2P-093; ADR 0204 §11): `root` (Ch10's mangrove root-walks), `snow` and `slate` (Ch12); a level's default is its scenes row, and env-art marks snow, root and slate patches with surface areas in the kits.

mesh_surfaces._note: M3-AUD-812: listen-only ground for levels that mark none. A MeshInstance3D whose own or parent's name matches a pattern (glob, any case) plays the rule's surface when its bounds, grown up_m over the top and down_m under the bottom, hold the feet. Level areas (surface_areas) win over these; among these the highest priority wins. LOD meshes (skip_suffix) are skipped; the zone is rescanned every rescan_sec.

rules._note: M2-FP-108: env-art's final Saltgrass Causeway: its stone path over the sand flats (the scene's default)

water_level._note: M3-AUD-812: wading. Feet under the rest plane of a sea in `group` (WaterSurface's publishers: the zone sea) by up to wade_m, with above_m of slack, step in `surface`.
